# Meeting Mind

> Meeting Mind is an AI meeting-intelligence app that records, transcribes, and summarizes meetings, phone calls, and lectures, then lets you ask questions about your recordings and get AI-powered answers with citations.

## What it does

- Background audio recording (works with the screen locked)
- Automatic speech-to-text transcription in 36+ languages, with speaker identification and timestamps
- AI-generated summaries: key points, decisions, and action items
- Q&A chat over your own recordings, with citations
- Phone call recording and transcription
- Meeting bot that auto-joins and records Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet calls from your calendar
- Cross-device sync (iOS, web, and in-progress Android/macOS/Windows clients)

## Who it's for

Professionals who attend recurring meetings, calls, or lectures and want an automatic record and summary instead of manual note-taking.

## Platforms

- iOS (iOS 17+): https://apps.apple.com/us/app/meeting-mind/id6757317991
- Android (Android 10+): coming soon on Google Play
- Web app: https://meetingmind.org/auth
- macOS and Windows desktop clients: https://github.com/tsushanth/SummaryAI/releases

## Pricing

Subscriptions are available weekly, monthly, or yearly, purchasable through the web app at a discount versus in-app purchase pricing on the App Store. A 7-day free trial is offered on the annual plan. Exact current prices are shown at https://meetingmind.org/#pricing and https://meetingmind.org/subscription.

## Company

Meeting Mind is made by Kreative Koala LLC.
